title: Console agent assignment inspector and controls
description:
## Purpose

Deliver the first safe issue-write controls in the console, centered on agent routing assignment. The work must make a clear distinction between immutable agent provenance and editable future-work routing.

## Acceptance

- Detail view shows an explicit **Agent assignment** section even when unassigned.
- It resolves the selected class/provider to a redacted effective configuration: product/provider, model, effort, service tier/flex mode, and relevant non-secret arguments.
- A human can safely update assignment, state, and comments through validated console APIs; all writes create normal Kanbus events and flow through realtime plus Git fallback.
- Assignment edits honor router claims and never alter immutable provenance or a live agent conversation without an explicit safe transition.
- Python/Rust configuration and mutation behavior remain parity-tested; console interactions have API/UI coverage.
